question: Does the Ming 1605 Inner Cabinet Library Catalog text directly pair the Zhunzhai clepsydra title with 孫逢吉 and an explicit era-unknown note, and how does that constrain later Song/Yuan attribution and title-variant handling?
answer: YES AT THE 1605 CATALOG-TEXT LAYER. SOURCE-BOUND DIRECT IMAGE REVIEW OF NLC892-1084-204844 PDF P105 READS 準齋几漏新式一冊, FOLLOWED BY 孫逢吉著莫詳時代, WITH 皇極經世衍數四十八冊不全 AS THE NEXT ENTRY. THIS CLOSES A MING-1605 TEXTUAL BIBLIOGRAPHIC TITLE/AUTHOR/UNKNOWN-ERA CONTROL. IT DOES NOT MAKE THE REVIEWED DIGITAL/PHYSICAL COPY A 1605 ORIGINAL, DOES NOT IDENTIFY THE AUTHOR WITH THE 1281 YANLING SUN FENGJI, DOES NOT PROVE SONG OR YUAN COMPOSITION, DOES NOT COLLAPSE 九漏/几漏/圖式/新式 TITLE VARIANTS, AND DOES NOT CLOSE PRE-1578 25-ARROW PROSE OR SANMING PARENTAGE.
